captains.name: Marisol Vega
captains.title: Captain
captains.bio: Heir to a bankrupt trading house, out to restore the family name one cargo at a time.
captains.closed_reason: The Admiralty yards at Kestrel Bay hold her family's old debts; she cannot show her face there.

captains.name: Tobias Wren
captains.title: Captain
captains.bio: Discharged Admiralty gunner. He shoots straight and sometimes thinks straight.
captains.closed_reason: Discharged in disgrace: Driftmoor and Isla Brasa will not let him ashore.

captains.name: Ines 'Ash' Calder
captains.title: Captain
captains.bio: A smuggler with a debt, a grin, and a talent for paperwork.
captains.closed_reason: Wanted in Saltmere for a little matter of forged customs seals.

captains.name: Okoro Bale
captains.title: Captain
captains.bio: A navigator who reads weather the way priests read scripture.
captains.closed_reason: Swore never to return to Lanterna, where his first ship went down.

captains.name: Hester Quill
captains.title: Captain
captains.bio: A harbour clerk who learned every merchant's tricks by writing them down. Now she uses them.
captains.closed_reason: Her old employers' agents run Ironreef and Tidewell; she stays well clear.

captains.name: Rafe Moreno
captains.title: Captain
captains.bio: Sailed under Grimmer's colours until he saw what they cost. Brings a schooner, a debt and a grudge.
captains.closed_reason: A deserter with a price on his head in Kestrel Bay and San Velo.

npcs.name: Joss Pruett, master of the Hammerhead
Wilma Hurst, mate of the Contract
Ezra Mott, of the Morning Star

saltmere.name: Governor Aldous Pike
saltmere.greeting: "Salt keeps meat, captain, and contracts keep colonies. I have both in need of moving."

coralhaven.name: Governor Imelda Reyes
coralhaven.greeting: "Coralhaven is small, so we remember who helps us. And who doesn't."

isla_brasa.name: Governor Tomas Fierro
isla_brasa.greeting: "The mountain smokes, the market shouts, and I sign papers. Make yourself useful."

kestrel_bay.name: Commodore-Governor Hugh Ashby
kestrel_bay.greeting: "The Admiralty yards build the ships. Captains like you keep them busy."

lanterna.name: Governor Celeste Moreau
lanterna.greeting: "The lighthouse never sleeps, and neither does trade. What can Lanterna offer you?"

driftmoor.name: Reeve Agnes Holloway
driftmoor.greeting: "Fog's thick today. Business is thicker, if you've the stomach for it."

san_velo.name: Governor Bartolo Cruz
san_velo.greeting: "The friars pray for honest traders. I pay them. Usually more promptly."

ironreef.name: Governor Magnus Thorne
ironreef.greeting: "Ironreef forges cannon for half the Reach. Somebody has to deliver them."

tidewell.name: Governor Liesl Vann
tidewell.greeting: "Every ship in the Reach drinks from our wells. Every ship owes us a favour."

puerto_ambar.name: Governor Rosa Ambrell
puerto_ambar.greeting: "My family built half these docks. I would like to see them busy again."
